reason: I already have a drawer full of half-used supplement bottles, and I know I'll stop after a week. A foil sachet every day also feels like a lot of trash for something I'm not sure I'll stick with.
objection: Thirty little foil packets is more packaging waste, and I'd probably quit halfway like every other bottle in my drawer. Paying $30 to find that out again isn't appealing.
would_change_my_mind: A creator video that hits my exact problem (waking up at 3am, tight shoulders) and shows the sachet in a real mom's day, plus a smaller trial pack of 7 sachets at around $9 so I'm not committing to a whole month.
